summary: Open-source project management platform alternative to Jira/Linear, offering task tracking, sprint management, documentation, and issue tracking with a modern tech stack.
usecases: Replace Jira/Linear in small to medium teams with a self-hosted, customizable project management solution.
Use as a centralized hub for sprint planning, bug tracking, and product roadmap visualization.
Integrate with CI/CD pipelines to auto-create issues from deployment failures or monitoring alerts.
ideas: Build a mobile app companion for real-time sprint updates and task tracking.
Develop a plugin system for integrating with external tools like Slack, GitHub, or Notion.
Create a white-label version for agencies to manage multiple client projects under one instance.
